name: Natural language (Flux, SD3, ...)
description: T5/LLM-encoded models that follow full sentences: Flux, SD3/3.5, HiDream, Chroma, Qwen-Image, Lumina.

expressions.admiration: The character looks on with quiet admiration: eyes slightly widened and bright, eyebrows gently raised, and a soft closed-mouth smile with a faint blush on the cheeks.
expressions.amusement: The character is amused, with a playful lopsided smirk, twinkling eyes and one eyebrow slightly raised, the head tilted a little to the side.
expressions.anger: The character is furious, brows drawn sharply together, eyes narrowed into a hard glare, and lips pulled back over clenched teeth.
expressions.annoyance: The character looks annoyed, with a small frown, pursed lips and half-lidded eyes glancing off to the side in mild irritation.
expressions.approval: The character shows approval with a calm, satisfied smile, relaxed eyes and a slight nod of the head.
expressions.caring: The character wears a caring, compassionate expression: a soft warm smile, gentle eyes, eyebrows tilted up with concern, and the head leaning slightly to one side.
expressions.confusion: The character looks confused, one eyebrow raised and the other furrowed, head tilted, lips slightly parted as if about to ask a question.
expressions.curiosity: The character is curious, eyes wide and attentive, eyebrows raised, head tilted, and lips slightly parted in interest.
expressions.desire: The character has a sultry, longing look, with half-lidded eyes, flushed cheeks and a faint smile while lightly biting the lower lip.
expressions.disappointment: The character looks disappointed, gaze lowered, eyebrows drooping and the corners of the mouth turned down.
expressions.disapproval: The character looks disapproving, with a stern frown, narrowed eyes and tightly pressed lips.
expressions.disgust: The character is disgusted, nose wrinkled, upper lip curled, eyes squinting in a grimace of revulsion.
expressions.embarrassment: The character is embarrassed, face flushed bright red, eyes darting away, with an awkward wobbly smile and a bead of sweat.
expressions.excitement: The character is thrilled, eyes wide and sparkling, eyebrows high, and mouth open in a big eager smile.
expressions.fear: The character is terrified, eyes wide with tiny pupils, eyebrows raised and drawn together, mouth open, and sweat on the brow.
expressions.gratitude: The character looks deeply grateful, eyes gently closed, a soft heartfelt smile, a light blush and a small happy tear.
expressions.grief: The character is overwhelmed with grief, sobbing with tears streaming down the cheeks, eyes squeezed shut and mouth open.
expressions.joy: The character is overjoyed, laughing with a wide open smile, eyes crinkled shut and cheeks rosy.
expressions.love: The character gazes lovingly, with a tender smile, soft half-lidded eyes and warmly blushing cheeks.
expressions.nervousness: The character is nervous, with an uneasy forced smile, worried eyebrows, a drop of sweat on the forehead and eyes glancing away.
expressions.neutral: The character has a calm, neutral expression, face relaxed, mouth closed and a steady gaze toward the viewer.
expressions.optimism: The character looks hopeful and optimistic, with a confident smile and bright eyes turned slightly upward.
expressions.pride: The character looks proud and smug, chin raised, eyes half-lidded and a self-satisfied smirk.
expressions.realization: The character has a sudden realization, eyes snapping wide, eyebrows shooting up and mouth falling open.
expressions.relief: The character looks relieved, eyes closed, letting out a long sigh with a small relaxed smile.
expressions.remorse: The character looks remorseful, eyes glistening with held-back tears, gaze lowered and lips pressed together.
expressions.sadness: The character is sad, eyes teary, eyebrows drooping and the mouth turned down, looking toward the ground.
expressions.surprise: The character is surprised, eyes wide, eyebrows raised high and mouth open in shock.
